milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining purple concrete with a pickaxe causes the block to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with an iron pickaxe but no purple_concrete, so this rule is not pre-satisfied. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly confirms the player both broke the block AND collected the drop (concrete yields nothing if mined bare-handed without a pickaxe).
